paite: Saltan akum sawmthumna, akha lina, huai kha ani ngana ah Kebar lui a saltangte lak a ka om lai in hichi ahong hi a, van hong kihong a, Pathian kilakna ka mu hi.
heading: Ezekiel In Pathian Amuhna Masa / (1.1-7.27) / Pathian Laltutphah
english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

paite: Huai kha ani ngana ah, huai tuh kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum ngana ahi,
english: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

paite: Kaldai gam a Kebar lui a Buzi tapa siampu Ezekiel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: huai ah TOUPA khut atung ah a-om hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.

paite: Huan ka en a, ngai in, mallam a kipan huihpi thupi mahmah ahong kuan a, meipi asah a sah, kuang zoizoi, akim tengteng tanvak puappuap asung mei laitak ah sik am bang a am a-om hi.
english: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

paite: Huchi in huai lai a kipan in thil hing li kibatpih ahong pawtkhia ua, akimuhdan uh hichibang ahi a: Mihing batna anei ua,
english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

paite: mai li anei chiat ua, kha li anei chiat uhi.
english: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

paite: Akhete uh atang a; akhepek nuailam uh bawngnou khepek bang ahi a; huan dalte mahmah bang in avakkhe zualzual uhi.
english: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

paite: Apang lite ua akha nuai uah mihing khut bang anei ua; huchi in ali un amel uleh akhate uh hichibang in apu uhi:
english: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

paite: Akhate uh akizom a; apai un leng akihei ngei kei ua, amazawn uah apai chiat uhi.
english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

paite: Amel un akibatpihte mihing mel bang ahi a, ali un ataklam pang uah humpinelkai mel apu ua, ali un aveilam pang uah bawngtal mel apu ua, ali un muvanlai mel apu nawn ua, amel uh huchibang ahi.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

paite: Huan akhate uh azakkhia ua, akha nihte un akizak zom chiat ua, nih in apumpi uh akhuh uh.
english: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

paite: Malam ah apai chiat ua, kha paina lam ding ah apai ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uhi.
english: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

paite: Thil hingte lak ah suangkuangthei ampha bang, meisel bang mai asuk leh tou in apai a; meibel a-ampha mahmah a, mei a kipan khophia ahong suakkhe zualzual hi.
english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

paite: Thil hingte khophe zualzual bang in avialtai uhi.
english: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

paite: Huan thil hingte ka et lai in, ngai in, thil hingte zul ah amel lite uh a ding in lei ah kangtalai liim khat zel ka mu hi.
english: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

paite: Kangtalai khe leh atatdan beril suang zia bang mai in alang a, ali un latdan khat anei ua, alatdan uh leh atatdan uh kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang ahi hi.
english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

paite: Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

paite: Akangtalai liim kual sangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahi a; ali un akual teng mit in adim uhi.
english: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

paite: Huchi in thil hingte apai chiang un azul uah kangtalai peite apai sam uhi; thil hingte lei a kipan dopkang a a-om uleh kangtalai liimte leng dopkang in a-om sam uhi.
english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

paite: Kha apai utna lam peuhmah ah apai ua; huai lam a kha apai zel ziak in; huchi in kangtalai liimte azul uah dopkang in a-om ua, thil hing kha kangtalai liimte ah a-om hi.
english: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

paite: Huaite apai chiang un hiaite apai uhi; huaite adin chiang un hiaite adingh ua; huaite lei a kipan a dopkang a a-om chiang un kangtalai liimte amau zul ah dopkang in a-om ua, kangtalai liimte ah thil hingte kha a-om hi.
english: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

paite: Thil hingte lutung ah van kibatpih a-om a, kristal vak bang a te mulkimhuaitak alutung uah akiphalh zeizoi hi.
heading: Pathian Thupina Muhna
english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

paite: Van dum nuai ah akha uh akop khat thil hing dangte sun in azak ua, akha uh kop khat in apumpi uh akhuh uhi.
english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

paite: Huan alen chiang un akha ging uh tui tampi mahmah ging bang, bangkim hihtheipa aw bang mai, mipi ging vengvung husa, sepaihhon husa bang mai in ka za a; adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
english: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

paite: Alutung ua vansin tung ah aw ahong om a, adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
english: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

paite: Huan alutung ua vansin tung ah laltutphah bang, sapphir suang bang mai a kimu a-om a; huai laltutphah batpih tung ah mihing bang a kilang a-om hi.
english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

paite: Akawng chiang tunglam sik hal-ap bang mai in ka mu a, akawng hileh kilawm chiang nuailam mei bang mai hi in ka mu a, avak kimvel lelaw hi.
english: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

paite: Vuahzuk ni a meipi tung a sakhituihup latdan bang in akim vak alang hi. Hiai TOUPA thupina latdan bang ahi. Huan ka muh in akhup in ka puk a, thugenpa aw ka za hi.
english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
